name: Yonsei University — Underwood International College
summary: Yonsei University's English-taught college in Seoul: 16 majors in three divisions, with a September intake for international students.

ib.text: No minimum IB score is published. IB English A (Language and Literature, or Literature) counts as proof of English; submitting IB results is optional but recommended. Selection is a document review plus interview.

apply.via: UIC online application or Common App

programmes.name: Underwood Division
programmes.about: UIC's founding division, set up in 2005, with a common curriculum on reasoning and communication and five majors: Comparative Literature and Culture, Economics, International Studies, Political Science and International Relations, and Life Science and Biotechnology.
programmes.selectionNote: Document review scored out of 200 and an online interview out of 100. 2027 Fall round: applications in March 2027, interviews in June; exact days not yet published.

programmes.name: Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences Division
programmes.about: Eight majors: Asian Studies, Culture and Design Management, Information and Interaction Design, Creative Technology Management, Justice and Civil Leadership, Quantitative Risk Management, Science, Technology and Policy, Sustainable Development and Cooperation.
programmes.selectionNote: Document review scored out of 200 and an online interview out of 100. 2027 Fall round: applications in March 2027, interviews in June; exact days not yet published.

programmes.name: Integrated Science and Engineering Division
programmes.about: Three science and engineering majors built on an interdisciplinary curriculum: Nano Science and Engineering, Energy and Environmental Science and Engineering, and Bio-Convergence, with experiment-based coursework.
programmes.selectionNote: Document review scored out of 200 and an online interview out of 100. 2027 Fall round: applications in March 2027, interviews in June; exact days not yet published.

notes: You are admitted to a division: the first major is picked within it at the end of the second semester, and a switch to a major outside the division is not allowed.

The international track is for applicants who are non-Korean with non-Korean parents; dual Korean citizenship makes you ineligible. Hard copies of documents must arrive by the deadline, which is never extended.

Newly admitted international students are considered automatically for an admissions scholarship of full tuition for four years, held on a GPA condition; the fee shown is the 2026 international-track rate per semester.
